v: pu॰ 6 ta॰ । caturarTyAM pARinyuktarapratyayanimitte SabdagaRe sa ca gaRaH aSman, yUTa, Uza, mIna, nada, darBa, vfnda, guda, KaRqa, naga, SiKA, kowa, pAma, kanda, kAnda, kula, gahva, guqa, kuRqala, pIna, guha ।
m: अश्मादि a g. of Pāṇ. iv, 2, 80.
अश्मान्तक m. N. of a plant (from the fibres of which a Brāhman's girdle may be made), Mn. ii, 43.
अश्मापिधान mfn. covered by a stone, PBr.
अश्मार्म n. a heap of ruins, stones of a ruin, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 91.
अश्मास्य (4) mfn. ‘having a stone-mouth or a stone-source’, flowing from a rock, RV. ii, 24, 4.
1. अश्म ifc. for 2. अश्मन्, a stone, Pāṇ. v, 4, 94.
2. अश्म (in comp. for 2. अश्मन्).
a: अश्मः — 1 A mountain, a rock (at the end of comp.). --2 (Ved.) A cloud.

s: klI, (aSmeva BAjayati cUrRitaM karoti । BajacUrRane । Baja + Ric + aR । pfzodarAditvAt jasya latvam .) dravyacUrRArTalOhAdipAtraM । tatparyyAyaH । lOhaBARqaM 2 । iti SabdacandrikA ॥ hAmAnadistA iti BAzA ॥
v: na॰ aSmeva BAjayati cUrRitaM karoti । Baja--Ric aR pfzo॰ jasya latvam । dravyacUrRakArake (hAmAnadiste) iti KyAte lOhapAtraBede SabdacandrikA ।
m: अश्म—भाल n. a stone mortar, L.

s: puM, (aSmano Bedo BavatyasmAt .) pAzARaBedI vfkzaH । iti ratnamAlA ॥ (asya guRAH । “aSmaBedo himastiktaH kazAyo vastiSoDanaH । Bedano hanti dozArSogulmakfcCrASmahfdrujaH ॥ yonirogAn pramehAMSca plIhaSUlabraRAni ca” । iti BAvaprakASaH ॥ “eraRqo vijapUraSca gokzuraM vfhatIdvayaM । aSmaBedastaTAvilva etanmUlaH kftaH SftaH ॥ eraRqatElahiNgAQyo yavakzAraH sasEnDavaH । stanakaRWakawImeQrahfdayotTavyaTAM jayet” ॥ iti SArNgaDaraH ॥)
m: अश्म—भेद [L.] or अश्म—भेदक [Suśr.], m. id.

v: pu॰ aSmAnamudBidya jAyate । pAzARaBedake vfkze । ka, aSmaBidaH । aR aSmaBedaH । Rvul । aSmaBedako'pyatra pu॰ ।
m: अश्म—भिद् m. the plant Coleus Scutellarioides (supposed to dissolve stone in the bladder), Suśr.

s: [d,] puM, (aSmAnaM BinattIti । aSma + Bid + kvip .) pAzARaBedI vfkzaH । iti ratnamAlA ॥ prastaraBedake tri ॥
puM, (aSmAnaM pAzARaM hanti BinattIti । aSma + han + wak .) pAzARaBedanavfkzaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ hATAjuqI iti BAzA ॥ aSmaBedaSabde'sya paryyAyaguRO jYAtavyO ॥
m: अश्म—घ्न m. N. of a plant, L.

a: अश्मंत — a. 1 Inauspicious., unlucky (अशुभ). --2 Unlimited. --तः N. of a Marut. --तं [अश्मनोंऽतोऽत्र शकं˚ पररूपम्] 1 A fireplace. --2 A field, plain. --3 Death.

अश्मंतकः --कं — 1 A fireplace. --2 The shade for a lamp (दीपाधार). --3 A kind of grass. --कः N. of several trees:--(a) अम्लोटक; its leaf; Māl. 9. 7; (b) N. of a tree कोविदारक; (c) N. of a plant from the fibres of which a Brāhmaṇa's girdle may be made.

m: अ-श्मशान-चित् mfn. not piled up in the form of a pyre, MaitrS.
not piling up &c., TS.
अ-श्मश्रु mfn. unbearded, GopBr.
अश्म—चूर्ण n. ground or powdered stone, KātyŚr.
अश्म—चक्र (अश्म.) mfn. furnished with a disk of stone, RV. x, 101, 7.
अश्म—चित mfn. covered with stones, PBr.

s: puM, (aSmAnaM dArayatIti । aSma + dF + Ric + lyuw .) waNkaH । pAzARavidAraRAstraM । iti jawADaraH ॥ wA~kI iti paScimadeSe KyAtaH ॥
v: pu॰ aSmAnaM dArayati df--Ric--lyu । pAzARaBedake waNkanAmAstre ।
m: अश्म—दारण m. an instrument for breaking stones, L.

v: tri॰ atiSayena dyotate yaN luk bA॰ qa vidyu AyuDam aSma vyApakaM aSmamayaM vA didyu yasya । aSmamayAyuDayukte । “vidyunmahaso naro aSmadidyavaH” 5, 54 । 3 । aSmadidyuvo vyAptAyuDAH aSmamayAyuDA vA” BA॰ ।
m: अश्म—दिद्यु (अश्म.) mfn. whose missile weapons are stones or thunderbolts, RV. v, 54, 3.

v: aSmana iva ganDo leSo'syAH । pfSinaparRRIlakzaRAyAmAsanDO latAyAm । “viSAKaSAvASmaganDApfSniparRRyaDyaRqASca” kAtyA॰ 20, 7, 17, “aSmaganDA AsanDiH pfSniparRRIlakzaReti” karka॰ । “na SaraM nASmaganDAM nADyaRqAM na pfSniparRRIM nASvatTasyAntike kuryyAt” Sata॰ brA॰ ।
m: अश्म—गन्धा (अश्म-), f. N. of a plant, ŚBr. xiii; KātyŚr. (cf. अश्व-गन्धा.)

s: puM, (aSmeva garBo yasya .) harinmaRiH । marakataM । ityamaraH ॥
v: pu॰ aSmeva kfto garBo'sya । “pannA iti” KyAte marakatamaRO । rAjani॰ ।
m: अश्म—गर्भ or अश्म—गर्भ-ज, n. an emerald, L.

k.v: गारुत्मतं मरकतमश्मगर्भो हरिन्मणिः। शोणरत्नं लोहितकः पद्मरागोऽथ मौक्तिकम्.।

s: klI, (aSmano garBAjjAyate iti । aSmagarBa + jan + qa .) marakataM । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ pAnnA iti BAzA ॥ (puM, pAzARajo vahniH .)
v: pu॰ aSmagarBAjjAyate jana--qa 5 ta॰ । marakatamaRO aSmayonirapyatra” rAjani॰ 2 prastaraje vahnO pu॰ ।

m: अश्म—गर्भ-मय mf(ई)n. consisting of emerald, Dharmaś.

v: pu॰ aSmanirmmito guqaH golAkAraH padArTaH । prastaranirmmite (gulI) prasidDe yudDasADane astraBede strItvamapi “SUlAn BuSuRqyaSmaguqAH sTUlAH kArzRAyasIstaTA” BA॰ dro॰ pa॰ । BuSaRqInirmuktA aSmaguqAstadarTaH ।
na॰ hanyate'nena hana--manin hanma AyuDam aSmanirmmitaM hanma । lOhanirmite AyuGe “agnitasteBiryuvamaSmahanmaBiH” f॰ 7, 104, 5 ।
m: अश्म—हन्मन् (अश्म-) n. a stroke of the thunderbolt, RV. vii, 104, 5.

v: strI aSmano jAtiH sAmAnyamasya । “pAnnA” KyAte marakatamaRO । aSmana iva jAtirasya । ratnamAtne amaraH ratnAni ca । “vajraM gArutmataM puzparAgo mARikyameva ca । indranIlaSca gomedastaTA vEdUryameva ca । mOktikaM vidrumaSceti ratnAnyuktAni vE nava” BAva॰ pra॰ । “muktAPalaM hIrakaM ca vEdUryyaM padmarAgakam । puzparAgaM ca gomedaM nIlaM gArutmataM taTA । prabAlayuktAnyetAti mahAratnAni vE nava” vizRu Da॰ । atra puzparAgAdInAM klIvatA'pi । atra cEzAM mahAratnatEtokteH tadBinnAnAmapi ratnatvamastyeva yaToktaM gAruqe “tezu rakzovizavyADivyAlaGnAnyaGahAni ca । prAdurBavanti ratnAni taTEva viguRAni ca । vajraM muktA maRayaH padmarAgAH samarakatASca proktAH । api cendranIlamaRayo vEdUryyAH puzparAgASca । karketanakuruvilvO ruDirAkzasamanvita sPawikam । vidrumamaRiSca” ।

s: klI, (aSmanaH prastarAjjAyate iti । aSman + jana + qa .) SilAjatu । ityamaraH ॥ lOhaM iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ (“adByo'gnirbakzmataH kzatrama no lohamutTitam । tezAM sarvvatragaM tejaH svAsu yonizu SAmyati ॥” iti manuH ॥ SilAjatvarTe vEdyakacakrapARisaMgrahasyASmarIrogacikitsAyAM varuRaGfte yaTA ॥ ‘amftA cASmajaM deyaM’ ॥)
v: na॰ aSmano jAyate jana--qa 5 ta॰ । prastarajAte 1 SilAjatuni, । aSmeva jAyate jana--qa । 2 lOhe ca ।
m: अश्म—ज n. ‘rock-born’, bitumen, L.
iron, L. (cf. Mn. ix, 321.)

k.v: गैरेयमर्थ्यं गिरिजमश्मजं च शिलाजतु। वोलगन्धरसप्राणपिण्डगोपरसाः समाः॥

v: na॰ aSmano jAyate jana--tun qicca । SilAjatuni svArTe kan aSmajatukaM tatrEva ।
m: अश्म—जतु n. bitumen, Car.

s: klI, (aSmajatu + svArTe kan .) SilAjatu । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ (SilAjatuSabde'sya viSezavivaraRaM jYeyaM ॥)

m: अश्मकी f. N. of several women, Hariv. &c.

v: pu॰ aSmeva sTiraH niScalatvAt ivArTekan । 1 fziBede “vedasTAnena vAtsyena taTASmakasumantunA” BA॰ SA॰ pa॰ । 2 dakziRadeSasTe deSaBede । “gantavyomalayaH SrImAn parvvato DAtumaRqita” ityupakramya “taTASmakA pulindASca kaliNgASca viSezataH” rA॰ ki॰ kA॰ । vfhatsaMhitAyAntu sa deSaH paScimottarasyAM diSi । “diSi paScimottarasyAM mARqavyatuzAratAlahanamadrAH । aSmakakulU nahaqastrIrAjyasiMhavanaKaRqAH” iti karmmaviBAge uktam” atauBatatrApi tannAmako deSaH । tasya janapadavAcitvAt taddeSa vAsizu tadrAjani ca tataH kftARo bahuza luk । 3 taddeSa vAsini 4 tadrAjani ca ba॰ va॰ । “sAlvAvayavapratyagraTakana kUlASmakAdiY” pA॰ sU॰ sAlvajanapadAvayavatvenokteH 5 sAlvadeSAvayave ca sAlvadeSaSca vfha॰ saM॰ kUrmmaviBAge navasu KaRqezu maDyaKaRqe uktaH “BAratavarze maDyAt prAgAdi viBAjitA deSAH BadrArimedamARqavyasARvanIpojjvihAnasaMKyAtAH” ityupakramya “gajAhvayaSceti maDyamidam” iti navaKaRqe kUrmmaBAge maDyaKaRqe tasya sTitiruktA ataH sAlvAvayavanAmako'SmakaH tadIyadakziRapradeSasTaH iti gamyate tena rAmAyaRavAkyaM tadvizayakamiti na viroDaH । aSmake sAlvAvayave BavaH iY ASmakiH । taddeSaBave tri॰ tadrAjani ca bahuzu luk ASmakAH sAlvAvayavAvaSmakavAsizu tadrAjasu ca ba॰ va॰ । striyAM na luk ASmakyaH । sAlvaSabde'sya vivftiH ।
m: अश्मक m. (g. ऋश्यादि, q.v.) N. of a son of Vasiṣṭha and Madayantī, MBh.; VP.
N. of a warrior tribe, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 173; R. &c. (cf. अवन्त्य्-अश्मकास्)
a: अश्मकः — [अश्मेव स्थिरः, इवार्थे कन्] 1 N. of a sage. --2 N. of a country in the south; तथाश्मकाः पुलिंदाश्च कलिंगाश्च विशेषतः Rām.; (probably an old name of Travancore); according to Bṛ. S. 14. 22 it is in the north-west. --3 The inhabitants of the country (pl.). --4 A part of the साल्व country or its inhabitants; or its king.
अश्मक — An old name of Travancore.

s: strI, (aSmA iva kadalIPalaM yasyAH .) kadalIviSezaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ asyAH guRaparyyAyO kAzWakadalISabde drazwavyO ॥
m: अश्म—कदली f. N. of a plant, L.
अश्मक—सुमन्तु m. N. of a Ṛṣi, MBh. xii, 1592.
अश्म—केतु m. N. of a plant, L.

v: pu॰ aSmani prastaraeva DAnyAdikaM kuwwayati kuwwaaR--upa॰ sa॰ । vAnaprasTaBede, tasyodUKalAdiSUnyatvena taRqulAdervituzIkaraRasya tatrEva viDAnAttaTAtvam । “aSmakuwwoBavedvApi dantolUKaliko'pi vA” manuH । Rvul । aSmakuwwako'pyatra । “dantolUKalikaH kAlapakvASI vASmakuwwakaH” yA॰ smftiH ।
m: अश्म—कुट्ट mfn. breaking or bruising with a stone (as grain), Mn. vi, 17; R.
अश्म—कुट्टक mfn. id., Yājñ. iii, 49.
अश्म—लोष्ट्र-न्याय m. the rule of the stone and clod of earth (used to denote the relative importance of two things, both of which may be unimportant), A.
अश्म—मूर्धन् mfn. having a head of stone, AitBr.
अश्म—मय mf(ई)n. (= अश्मन्-मय, q.v.) made of stone, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; Mn.
a: अश्ममय, अश्मवत् — a. Stony, made of stone.

v: pu॰ aSrute vyApnoti, saMhantyanena vA karttari karaRe vA manin । pAzARe । “aTa yadaSru saMkzarita mAsIt so'Sma pfSniraBavat” Sata॰ brA॰ । “iyattakaH kuzumBakastakaM BinadmyaSmanA” f॰ 1 । 191 । 15 । “aSiSakiByAM Candasi” ityukteH vedeasya BUriprayogaH kvacit loke'pi “nArAcakzepaRIyASmanizpezapatitAnalam” raGuH । dantolUKakikaH kAlapakvASI vASmakuwwakaH” yA॰ “aSmAnaM dfzadaM manye manye kAzWamudUKalam । anDAyASca sutaM manye yasya mAtA na paSyati” jinendraH । 2 meGe niru॰ tasyAmbaravyApakAtvAttaTAtvam 3 BUBivyApake parvvate pu॰ । “aSmAnaM cidye biBiduH” f॰ 4, 16, 6 । “aSmAnaM parvvataM meGaM vA” BA॰ । “aSmAnaM cicCavasA didyutaH f॰ 5 । 304 । “aSmAnaM parvvatam” BA॰ । 4 vyApake tri॰ aSmadidyuSabde udA॰ । ta॰ sa॰ uttarapadasTaH saMjYAyAM jAtO ca wacaM samAsAntaM laBate । saMjYAyAm piRqASmaH jAtO amftASmaH । nityasamA॰ । aSmanA kzuRRaH ASmanaH । fSyAdi॰ caturarTyAM ka । aSmakaH । aSmAdi॰ caturarTyAM raH aSmaraH । utkarA॰ caturarTyAM Ca । aSmIyaH । tadarhatItyarTe aSva । di॰ WaR । ASmikaH । tatra kuSala ityarTe AkarzAdi॰ kan । aSmakaH । apatyeSumrA॰ Qak । ASmeyaH । aSvA॰ gotrApatye PaY । ASmAyanaH । aSmanovikAraH aR wilopaH ASmaH mayaw ca aSmamayaH striyAM NIp । avayavArTe tu na wilopaH ASmana ityeva ।
m: 1. अश्मन् m. an eater, AV. xviii, 4, 54.
2. अश्मन् m. (once अश्मन्, ŚBr. iii), a stone, rock, RV. &c.
a precious stone, RV. v, 47, 3; ŚBr. vi
any instrument made of stone (as a hammer &c.), RV. &c.
thunderbolt, RV. &c.
a cloud, Naigh.
the firmament, RV. v, 30, 8; 56, 4; vii, 88, 2
अश्मन् [cf. Zd. asman; Pers. aṣmān; Lith. akmů; Slav. kamy].
a: अश्मन् — a. Ved. Eating or pervading. --m. [अश्नुते व्याप्नोति संहंत्यनेन बा˚ मनिन् Uṇ. 4. 146] 1 A stone; नाराचक्षेपणीयाश्मनिष्पेषोत्पतितानलं R. 4. 77. --2 A hard stone, rock. --3 Flint. --4 A cloud. --5 A thunderbolt. --6 A mountain. --Comp. --आस्य a. having a stone-mouth or source, flowing from a rock. --उत्थं bitumen. --कदली N. of a plant, a kind of कदली. --कुट्ट, --कुट्टक a. {1} breaking anything on stones. {2} broken by a stone. --(ट्टः, --ट्टकः) a class of devotees; a वानप्रस्थ; Y. 3. 49; Ms. 6. 17. --केतुः [अश्मेव केतुर्यस्य] N. of a plant. --गंधा N. of a plant. --गर्भः, --र्भं, --गर्भजः, --जं, --योनिः an emerald. --गर्भजः fire produced from a flint. --गुडः --डा a kind of weapon. --घ्नः N. of a tree. --चक्र a. furnished with a disc of stone. --जः, --जं {1} red-chalk. {2} iron. --जतु n., --जतुकं bitumen. --जातिः an emerald named पान्ना. --दारणः an axe or crow for breaking stones. --(णं) breaking stones or rocks. --दिद्यु a. one who has obtained a stony weapon, having adamantine weapons or grasped weapons (व्याप्तायुध, अश्ममयायुध). --पुष्पं bitumen, benzoin. --भालं a mortar of stone or iron. --भिद्, --भेदः, --भेदकः the plant Coleus Scutellarioides (supposed to dissolve stone in the bladder.). --रथः N. of a sage. --व्रज a. included in rocks. --सार a. like iron or stone. --(रः, --रं) {1} iron; प्राणाः सत्वरमश्मसारकठिना गच्छंति गच्छंत्वमी S. D. {2} sapphire. ˚मय a. made of iron. --हन्मन् n. {1} a weapon of iron; Rv. 7. 104. 5. {2} a stroke of the thunderbolt.

k.v: पाषाणप्रस्तरग्रावोपलाश्मानः शिला दृषत्. कूटोऽस्त्री शिखरं शृङ्गं प्रपातस्त्वतटो भृगुः॥

m: अश्म—नगर n. N. of the town in which Kālakeya resided, R. vii.

v: tri॰ aSmanovikAraH mayaw vede na nalopaH । pAzARamaye striyAM NIp । “SatamaSmanmayInAM purAmindro vyAsyat” f॰ 4 । 30 । 20 । “loke tu aSamamayaH । “abjamaSmamayaYcEva” iti manuH ।
m: अश्मन्—मय mf(ई)n. made of stone, RV. iv, 30, 20; x, 67, 3; 101, 10 (cf. अश्म-मय.)

a field, L.

m: 1. अश्मन्तक n. a fireplace, L.
